card.name: Words just before 'metabolism' or 'metabolized'
card.fires_on: Words right before 'metabolism' or 'metabolized' in drug-label text, such as 'hepatic', 'extensive', 'extensively' or 'significantly'. It also fires on 'is' or 'undergoes' when the next word is likely to be 'metabolized'.
